info.title: LiquiLens MCP
info.description: Free, read-only bank and lender research over cited public records. Tools find covered institutions, review public asset-quality disclosures and RBI supervisory evidence, and keep source dates, coverage gaps and evidence states visible. Outputs are research screens, not credit ratings, credit approval or investment advice.

post.description: Sends Model Context Protocol messages to the hosted LiquiLens server over Streamable HTTP. The agent runtime manages the session, so makers do not call this operation directly.

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: Media types the MCP server may return.
